sentences.text: O n the contrary, learned counsel for the respondent/State opposes the bail application on the ground that FSL report is positive; therefore, he prayed for rejection of this bail application.
sentences._hearing_file: Rabi @ Anurag Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023.json

sentences.text: I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case-diary.
sentences._hearing_file: Rabi @ Anurag Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023.json

sentences.text: According to learned counsel for the applicant, prosecutrix was aged more than 16 years at the time of incident and she has disclosed in her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. that she was having consensual relationship with the applicant.
sentences._hearing_file: Rabi @ Anurag Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023.json

sentences.text: School record seized during the investigation shows that date of birth of prosecutrix was 14.05.2007 and date of incidence was 07.02.2023.
sentences._hearing_file: Rabi @ Anurag Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023.json

sentences.text: On the basis of date of birth, age of prosecutrix comes below the age of 16 years at the time of incidence.
sentences._hearing_file: Rabi @ Anurag Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023.json

sentences.text: No document to challenge this age has been filed by the applicant.
sentences._hearing_file: Rabi @ Anurag Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023.json

sentences.text: Looking to the age of prosecutrix, this Court is not inclined to allow this bail application.
sentences._hearing_file: Rabi @ Anurag Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023.json

sentences.text: Accordingly, this bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of applicant stands dismissed.
sentences._hearing_file: Rabi @ Anurag Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023.json

sentences.text: On the contrary, learned counsel for the respondent/State as well as for objector oppose the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
sentences._hearing_file: Rabi @ Anurag Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case-diary.
sentences._hearing_file: Rabi @ Anurag Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 December, 2023.json

sentences.text:
This bail application has been argued on the ground that the prosecutrix, her mother and her grandparents have failed to support the prosecution story, but this fact was considered in the earlier bail application as well,
which was dismissed in M.Cr.C. No.21572/2023 and it was observed that despite consensual relationship of prosecutrix with the applicant the bail application cannot be allowed, as the age of prosecutrix was below 16 years at the time of incident.
sentences._hearing_file: Rabi @ Anurag Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: The bail application has been supported by the mother of prosecutrix, who is being represented here through her counsel.
sentences._hearing_file: Rabi @ Anurag Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: For the reason mentioned in the earlier bail order, no objection given by the mother of prosecutrix cannot be the basis of allowing second bail application.
sentences._hearing_file: Rabi @ Anurag Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Further, the DNA report has been received in the case and it confirms the sexual relationship between the applicant and the prosecutrix.
sentences._hearing_file: Rabi @ Anurag Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: For the age of prosecutrix, the State has relied upon her school record and appreciation of evidence on that fact cannot be undertaken by this Court while deciding the bail application.
sentences._hearing_file: Rabi @ Anurag Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Having considered all these facts, bail application is hereby dismissed.
sentences._hearing_file: Rabi @ Anurag Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 December, 2023.json

opennyai_summary.facts:
This is second application under section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure, for grant of bail filed on behalf of the applicant relating to FIR/Crime No.45/2023 dated 07.02.2023 registered at Police Station- Ramnagar, District- Satna, for the offence punishable under Sections 342, 457, 376 and 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 5l/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.
His earlier application being M.Cr.C.No.21572/2023 was dismissed on merits vide order dated 19.06.2023 passed by this Court.
opennyai_summary.final__arguments: He submits that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the present case because it is a case of consent.
opennyai_summary.final__ANALYSIS:
Further, the DNA report has been received in the case and it confirms the sexual relationship between the applicant and the prosecutrix.
For the age of prosecutrix, the State has relied upon her school record and appreciation of evidence on that fact cannot be undertaken by this Court while deciding the bail application.
opennyai_summary.final__decision: Having considered all these facts, bail application is hereby dismissed.
